description: Contagion through a name that holds a string in JS: `const key = 'skip'` holds a string of the vocabulary, and the callee of `Reflect.get(it, key)('adds', …)` — read whole, the arguments of the call it holds included — holds `key`: head declares 'adds' through a use of the vocabulary, at least a WARN that it may skip it. The real runner skips the test.
